text:
elaine: Heads-up — onboarding request from AcmeBank: they want HSM BYOK audit events forwarded to their SIEM (via our Audit-Sentinel) and an RBAC change so their ops group (kms-ops-acme) can view raw HSM audit logs for 90 days. Any gotchas?

mike_sec: Important to confirm what 'raw' means. HSM vendors often redact or forbid exporting low-level attestation logs. Also need to check FIPS/PCI constraints. Do we have precedent?

anya_dev: We did a forwarding POC for partner last quarter. The flow was: HSM -> proxy sidecar -> audit-sentinel -> customer SIEM. We used signed envelopes and an HMAC per-batch. Config snippet (rough):
```
audit_forwarder:
  enabled: true
  destination: https://audit-sentinel.redwood/inbound
  signing_key: kms:///proxy-signing-key
  include_kek_metadata: false
```
That kept raw payloads off the wire but allowed verifiable delivery.

jordan_pcm: From compliance side: 90d retention is OK, but need an explicit data processing agreement + proof of deletion clause. Also add a note: if logs contain customer key material (they shouldn't), we can't forward.

mike_sec: Also doing RBAC change to let kms-ops-acme view logs = we must gate that behind a scoped, audited role with just-view and no export. Recommend ephemeral access tokens + approval workflow (SaaS-request).

elaine: Good point. Acme specifically asked for ability to search by key id and see op-level events (wrap/unwrap, sign). They suggested read-only.

ops_oncall: Quick practical: our current HSM exporter creates entries like: 
`TS|HOST|OP|KEY_ID|ACTION|STATUS|DETAILS`
DETAILS sometimes includes vendor error codes. Does Acme need vendor microcodes? if so, escalate to vendor legal.

sre_bot: deploy-bot: audit-forwarder v2 deployed to staging at 2026-03-18T04:12Z :white_check_mark:

anya_dev: For KMS integration, watch the handshake: our proxy does a double-wrap with customer KEK to prove possession without exposing key material. That pattern satisfies most regs. If customer insists on raw HSM attestation objects, we need vendor sign-off.

mike_sec: There's also a CVE I flagged yesterday in the exporter lib (CVE-2026-1357) — affects buffer parsing of vendor logs. Patch available in v2.1.1, do not enable forwarding without upgrading.

elaine: Noted — we'll require v2.1.1 and a signed attestation before enabling.

jordan_pcm: Incident response note: add a playbook for forwarded logs: if SIEM reports suspicious unwraps, our oncall must trigger a cross-team call + generate a sealed evidence package from the HSM (timestamped) before any rewraps. Document chain-of-custody.

ops_oncall: I'll draft runbook stub. Also we should add audit-alerting rules for anomalous key usage (rate spikes, cross-region unwrap).

mike_sec: Action items: 1) confirm vendor policy re: raw attestations, 2) enforce exporter v2.1.1, 3) create RBAC template with ephemeral approvals, 4) legal DPA addendum. I'll file tickets. :thumbsup:

elaine: Thanks — please tag me on the tickets. I'll coordinate with Acme's security contact. :pray:
